descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94513 AC 11, AC 18 · “Deleting a patient on one device removes it from the other in real time”.

Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S24 Interim, same session in Hospital: two open sessions stay in step, and a patient deleted elsewhere leaves the open list

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Data syncs between a physician's devices in real time. A pre-round started on one device can be seen and continued on the other without re-entering anything. … (TFA-94513 AC 11; TFA-94513 AC 18) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Two browser contexts on one account (one storageState), on the Hospital list and chart

When Change the chart in one context and watch the other; delete a patient elsewhere while the list is open

Then The other context shows the change without a reload, and the deleted patient leaves the open list without a reload.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): reactivity.spec.ts assertions, judged against T3 (real-time sync; a delete removes the patient from the other device) as interim evidence only: both contexts share one session and run in Hospital only, so they do not show AC 10's separately signed-in devices or Nursing Home. The two-sign-in, both-modes version is TC-25 S01/S02 (lane C), which owns T3's design.

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: MULTI · Multi-device / multi-account — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).
